summary: The brick, copper and stone palette reads as steampunk, but the build is a hollow box with a flat green lid, an open see-through front and a broken back wall, and its brief elements (gear window, sawtooth skylights, crane, pipes) barely read.

issues.problem: The roof is a flat or stepped green copper slab with a glass strip. It reads as a lid, not a sawtooth or curved roof, and the skylights are not distinct.
issues.fix: Replace it with a sawtooth roof preset: 3-4 repeating ridges, each with a vertical glass face on the same side, in oxidised copper stairs and slabs. Add a short parapet around the edge.

issues.problem: The front face is open and see-through, with missing wall sections, glass showing sky, and a ragged stone frame. The back wall has a large hole under the roofline, and an arch-shaped cutout near the top shows sky.
issues.fix: Close the shell by filling the front and back walls solidly with brick. Then cut deliberate openings only for the door, windows and loading bay, each framed with stone trim.

issues.problem: The big round gear window is not readable. The upper front only shows a jagged sky-coloured gap and glass shards. The crane, valves and pipes are tiny or absent, and only a thin copper pipe is visible on the side.
issues.fix: Build a circular ring window about 7 blocks wide with a copper rim and iron-bar spokes, placed centred above the door. Add a crane from a fence or iron-bar jib with a chain hanging over the loading door, plus thick copper-block pipe runs with button or lever valves on the walls.

issues.problem: There are stray floating blocks and uneven edges: loose stone stubs at the base, a copper block floating beside the back wall, and a ragged top edge on the back wall. The ground-floor interior also reads as a mess of dark blobs.
issues.fix: Run the orphan and floating checks and delete the strays. Square off the base with a continuous stone plinth, and clean up the back-wall crown with a straight cornice line.

issues.problem: A plain cube with little projection. Chimneys are the only vertical accent and are short, and there is no side annex or bay to give a workshop silhouette.
issues.fix: Add one or two tall brick stacks, 8+ blocks above the roof, with banded copper tops. Also add a lean-to or loading-bay projection on one side.
